props.gloss_en: the mishna: one who flays [an animal] for a carpet -- [the hide is joined to the flesh] up to the grasping-measure
R' Yochanan ben Nuri: the hide on the neck is not joined
the Sages: [the neck hide] is joined until he flays all of it
Rav: [beyond the grasping-measure] the flayed part is pure
R' Asi: the handbreadth [of flayed hide] next to the flesh is impure
the baraita: one who flays this measure -- from here on, one who touches the flayed part is pure
the baraita: [one who touches] the hide opposite the flesh -- impure
the baraita: one who flays ... for a carpet -- the grasping-measure; and the handbreadth next to the flesh is pure
a baraita: how much is the grasping-measure? a handbreadth
another baraita: two handbreadths
Abaye: [the first baraita's handbreadth is] a doubled handbreadth
a baraita: how much is the grasping-measure? a doubled handbreadth
the mishna there: a garment one began to tear -- once most of it is torn, it is no longer joined, and it is pure
Rabba bar Avuh: they taught this only of a garment that is tevulat yom
Rabba bar Avuh: since he did not spare it and immersed it, he will not spare it and will tear most of it
Rabba bar Avuh: but a garment that is not tevulat yom -- not [pure when most is torn]; a decree lest he come not to tear most of it
per R' Elazar b. R' Shimon, the bird burnt-offering [is done with] the majority of two [simanim]
the stam: for Torah impurity, indeed [one would decree]; here [the mishna] deals with rabbinic impurity
the stam: [the 'impure' animal of the mishna is] a tereifa
Avuha di-Shmuel: a tereifa that one slaughtered imparts impurity in sacrifices
R' Shimon: one who flays sheratzim -- [the hide] is joined until he flays all of it
R' Shimon b. R' Yosei: they taught [Kelim 28:8] only when he did not leave a scarf's measure; if he left a scarf's measure -- joined
Reish Lakish: they taught this only of a garment; but a hide [torn for the most part] is [considered] whole
R' Yochanan: even a hide is not [considered] whole
R' Yehuda: a hide impure with midras, which he intended for straps and sandals -- once he put the knife to it, it is pure
the Sages: [not pure] until he reduces it below five handbreadths
Abaye: they dispute a protector apt to detach by itself -- one master holds it is a protector, and one holds it is not
the mishna: an oven that became impure -- how is it purified? one divides it into three and scrapes off the plaster until it is on the ground
R' Meir: he need neither scrape the plaster nor [take it] to the ground; rather he reduces it from within below four handbreadths

Rava: this is what [the mishna] says -- an impure oven: all agree one divides it into three and scrapes the plaster to the ground; one who wants his oven never to become impure -- [the first tanna:] divides and scrapes; R' Meir: reduces it from within below four
R' Meir: an oven -- its start is four [handbreadths], and its remains four
the Sages: when is this said? of a large [oven]
the Sages: but of a small one -- its start is any size; once its work is finished, its remains in its majority
the school of R' Yannai: 'any size' is a handbreadth, for they make girls' ovens of a handbreadth
Abaye: [the clause means] the remains of a large one in its majority
R' Yishmael b. R' Yosei: and even if he left a scarf's measure [it is not joined]
Reish Lakish: they taught this only of a garment; but [the scarf's measure left in] a hide is significant
R' Yochanan: even [in] a hide it is not significant

supports.gloss_en: תניא נמי הכי: כמה כדי אחיזה? טפח כפול
כדאבוה דשמואל: a slaughtered tereifa imparts impurity in sacrifices -- so the mishna's tereifa can be an impure animal

objections.gloss_en: מיתיבי: from here on, one who touches the flayed part is pure -- מאי לאו even the handbreadth next to the flesh?

answered_by.gloss_en: לא, לבר מטפח הסמוך לבשר -- no: [the flayed part] except the handbreadth next to the flesh

objections.gloss_en: תא שמע: the hide opposite the flesh is impure -- so the handbreadth next to the flesh is pure

answered_by.gloss_en: תנא: כל טפח הסמוך לבשר עור שכנגד הבשר קרי ליה -- the tanna calls the whole adjacent handbreadth 'the hide opposite the flesh'

objections.gloss_en: תא שמע: ... and the handbreadth next to the flesh is pure

answered_by.gloss_en: הכא במאי עסקינן -- בטפח ראשון: here it deals with the first handbreadth

objections.gloss_en: והא תניא: טפחיים -- but it was taught: two handbreadths!

answered_by.gloss_en: אמר אביי: טפח כפול -- a doubled handbreadth

objections.gloss_en: שתי תשובות בדבר: חדא -- שמא יאמרו טבילה בת יומא עולה: [decree on the tevulat yom garment too,] lest they say a same-day immersion avails

answered_by.gloss_en: אמר ליה רב יוסף: ... קרעה מוכיח עליה -- its tear proves [why it is pure]

objections.gloss_en: ועוד -- עולת העוף לרבי אלעזר ברבי שמעון ליגזר, דילמא לא אתי למעבד רוב שנים: then let him decree for the bird burnt-offering too, lest one not do the majority of two

answered_by.gloss_en: כהנים זריזים הן -- priests are vigilant

objections.gloss_en: תא שמע: for a carpet -- the grasping-measure; so beyond it, pure. Why? ליגזר -- let him decree lest he do only the grasping-measure, and he touches impurity and we declare him pure!

answered_by.gloss_en: אי בטומאה דאורייתא -- הכי נמי; הכא בטומאה דרבנן (= p_okimta_tumah_derabanan)

objections.gloss_en: תינח טמא בטהורה; טהור בטמאה -- טומאה דאורייתא היא! -- granted an impure man flaying a pure animal; a pure man flaying an impure one is Torah impurity
טרפה בת טמויי היא? -- is a tereifa capable of imparting impurity?

answered_by.gloss_en: אין, כדאבוה דשמואל: a slaughtered tereifa imparts impurity in sacrifices

objections.gloss_en: תא שמע: one who flays sheratzim -- joined until he flays all of it; הא בגמל אינו חבור -- so with a camel, not joined [beyond the grasping-measure, no decree]

answered_by.gloss_en: לא תימא הא בגמל אינו חבור, אלא אימא: בעור שעל הצואר אינו חבור, ורבי יוחנן בן נורי היא

objections.gloss_en: איתיביה: ... כי ממעיט ליה מיהא טהור, אמאי? לימא חלים! -- reduced below five, it is at any rate pure; why not say it is whole?

answered_by.gloss_en: כי קאמרי דחלים, היכא דקא צרי ליה להדיא; הכא -- במקצע ובא לו דרך סביבותיו: when I said 'whole', where he cut it straight; here he cuts all around

objections.gloss_en: מתיב רבי ירמיה: for a carpet -- the grasping-measure; so beyond it, pure. Why? לימא חלים!

answered_by.gloss_en: תרגמה רבי אבין: ראשון ראשון עושה ניפול -- piece by piece it becomes fallen away

objections.gloss_en: מתיב רב יוסף: the neck hide -- R' Yochanan ben Nuri: not joined. Why? הא חלים וקאי -- it is whole and standing!

answered_by.gloss_en: אמר ליה אביי: אימא סיפא, וחכמים אומרים חבור [-- that would support Reish Lakish]; אלא אמר אביי: בשומר העשוי לינתק מאליו קא מיפלגי (= p_abaye_shomer_heasui_lintak)

objections.gloss_en: מתיב רבי ירמיה: the oven -- R' Meir: reduces it from within below four; כי ממעט לה מיהא טהור, אמאי? לימא הא חלים וקאי!

answered_by.gloss_en: אמר ליה רבא: ואימא מדרבנן -- גורר את הטפילה עד שיהא בארץ [-- that would support Reish Lakish]; אלא אמר רבא: הכי קאמר ... (= p_rava_hachi_kaamar_tanur)

objections.gloss_en: אמר מר: חולקו לשלשה. ורמינהו: ... the Sages: of a large one [remains of four]; טעמא דאיכא שייריו ארבע, הא ליכא שייריו ארבע -- טהור [even without dividing in three]

answered_by.gloss_en: אמרי: התם דצלקיה מצלק, הכא דעבדיה גיסטרא -- there he cut it horizontally; here he made it a shard

objections.gloss_en: אמר מר: שייריו ברובו -- רובו דטפח למאי הוי? -- [if 'any size' is a handbreadth,] what use is the majority of a handbreadth?

answered_by.gloss_en: אמר אביי: שיירי גדול ברובו (= p_abaye_shirei_gadol_berubo)

objections.gloss_en: והאמרי רבנן ארבעה? -- but the Rabbis said [the large oven's remains are] four!

answered_by.gloss_en: לא קשיא: הא בתנורא בר תשעה, הא בתנורא בר שבעה -- one of a nine-handbreadth oven, the other of a seven

objections.gloss_en: איתיביה: ... כי ממעט מיהא טהור, אמאי? לימא חשיב!

answered_by.gloss_en: הכא במאי עסקינן -- דקא בעי ליה למושב זב: here he wants it for a zav's seat (no speaker marked; Steinsaltz gives it to Reish Lakish)
